remarks: Desirable Springdale location boasts a well maintained and inviting three-bedroom, three-level Rowhouse and outdoor patio offering exceptional value with no HOA's. Spacious home has a total square feet of 2364 living space, features gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances and sliding doors to private, fenced-in new patio, comfortable living room, adjacent dining room and powder room. Second floor reveals large primary bedroom with two closets, two additional bedrooms, full bath as well as a rec/family/playroom or office in the partially finished 680 sq. ft. lower level. With in-unit laundry and plenty of parking. Enjoy living in the heart of this desirable community with great schools and easy access to trains shops and restaurants.
